newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Lend Lease shares reach record high.
newsitem.headline: Lend Lease shares reach record high.

text.p: Shares in property and financial services Lend Lease Corporation Ltd jumped to a record high A$25.50 on Wednesday after it finalised its ISSC Australia alliance with government-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp and International Business Machines.
The information technology joint venture will be owned 51 percent by IBM, 23 percent by Lend Lease and 26 percent by Telstra.
"That is all you can put it down to, although they are terribly volatile," said a Melbourne-based dealer, noting the tightly held nature of the shares exaggerated its price moves.
Lend Lease said the deal had been foreshadowed in April 1996 was was expected to be signed in late July 1997.
By 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), Lend Lease shares had eased from their highs to be 15 cents stronger at A$25.35 on turnover of 161,862 shares.
